description: Scene sharp and nearly unchanged between f2470 and f2471.
Focus blur and corner darkening ramp up across f2472-f2475 (f2472 slightly soft, f2473 softer, f2474 strongly blurred). Measured peak at f2473 mean diff 12.99.
Title text "step 1 : attack first!" first present at f2475, fully formed in that tile; no partial letters seen in sampled frames.
Blurred scene and title unchanged f2475-f2477.
Title at full size over blurred scene, static.
Title narrows/shrinks to a small squeezed form at f2510 while scene still blurred (scale-down of text).
Title gone and background fully sharp at f2511: text exit and blur release occur in one frame step (measured peak f2510 diff 16.17).
Sharp sloth back view static, small slight pose shifts at tile scale only.
Claw crop looks the same across all 8 tiles; measured diff 3.23 is low and likely sub-pixel drift or compression; no change resolvable at 480x270.
Sloth stands upright; man static; only tiny head/arm shifts at tile scale.

Sloth abruptly in forward-lean pose with head lowered and forearm sweeping (large pose change between f3121 and f3122, then arm moves across f3123-f3125). Measured peak f3121 diff 10.85. Intermediate drawing not seen.
Sloth body bobs and forelimbs/claws cycle position across tiles; head stays left.
Blurred background trunks and canopies shift horizontally/change layout across tiles, consistent with scrolling background (INFERRED, loop vs pan unknown).
Wide classroom view becomes a tighter view on the man across f3315-f3320 (man grows, board shrinks off-screen); settled by ~f3320. Measured peak f3318 diff 21.14.
Frame content shifts leftward (chalk text exits left, wall poster and bowl enter at right) during the same f3315-f3320 span.
Zoomed framing holds, only tiny shifts.
Sloth eye appears drawn closed/lidded in f3514-f3515 (low resolution).
Eye open from f3516; body and forelimbs continue bobbing.
Blurred background trees shift/rearrange across tiles (scrolling, mechanism unknown). Measured peak f3517 diff 13.00.
Top-down sloth and tiny man both translate rightward by roughly 70px native across f3686-f3693; man trails/precedes sloth at nearly constant spacing.
Tiny red dash-like mark visible adjacent to the man/sloth claws from f3687; identity unavailable at this scale. Measured diff only 1.19.
Sloth eye drawn closed/lidded in f3783-f3784; man left arm low.
Sloth eye open; man arms swing: left arm extends left (f3786-f3788), then arms reposition (f3789-f3790). Sloth head essentially fixed. Measured peak f3786 diff 15.66.
